lp_tagline: A keyboard that suggests a calmer wording for the message you are typing. Facts, times and numbers stay, the sharp edges go.
lp_status: In development — test versions for Android and iOS.
sup_li_android: Android: Settings → System → Keyboard → Manage keyboards → turn on The Pill. Then select it in the keyboard switcher.
sup_li_ios: iPhone: Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard → The Pill → turn on “Allow Full Access” (without it the keyboard cannot call the server).
sup_li_app: In The Pill app, enter the server address and leave suggestions on.
sup_p_none: The suggestion comes after a short pause for messages longer than 12 characters. It never shows in password fields. When the server does not answer, the keyboard stays silent and you type as usual.
sup_p_contact: Send a bug or an idea to {mail}.
priv_intro: The Pill (com.ol1n.thePill) by Oldřich Vořechovský (ol1n) is a keyboard that suggests a calmer wording for the message you are typing. It has no account, ads, analytics or tracking.
priv_li1: What is sent: when a message has at least 12 characters, the keyboard sends the draft, after a short pause, to the pill-core server configured in the app. The text is replaced only if you tap the suggestion.
priv_li2: Never sent from password or other sensitive fields, or when suggestions are off or no server is set.
priv_li3: Where: the language model runs on the operator's own hardware, not a third-party AI service. pill-core does not store or log message text, only content-free operational data.
priv_li4: On device: the server address, access token and the suggestions toggle are stored only on your phone.
